gates.title: Independent source and security review
gates.accountability: Qualified reviewer independent from implementation owner
gates.required_acceptance: Human review record with findings, SHA-bound approval, ownership and dependency decisions
gates.required_evidence: GitHub review and security findings with exact PR heads

gates.title: Enforced private branch protection
gates.required_acceptance: API/settings proof of required status checks, review/required approval, and merge denial when failing
gates.required_evidence: Private main branch/ruleset policy export and negative merge check

gates.title: Real OneCall and MetaAutomate identity federation
gates.accountability: OneCall auth owner and MetaAutomate security lead
gates.required_acceptance: Actual issuer and peer verification, token revocation, atomic dual-JTI, cross-tenant isolation, key lifecycle
gates.required_evidence: Non-public staging test traces and security report

gates.title: Authorized read-only provider access
gates.accountability: Provider/data owner and MetaAutomate integration lead
gates.required_acceptance: Named provider, approved scope, contractual consent, server-bound tenant and egress controls, privacy impact
gates.required_evidence: Provider authorization, adapter test proof, data minimization assessment

gates.title: Durable delivery, webhook and resilience
gates.required_acceptance: Replay-proof signed webhook, durable idempotency, bounded retry/backoff, rate control and outage recovery
gates.required_evidence: Authenticated staging job receipts, replay denial logs, incident drills

gates.title: Verified human approvals and provider receipts
gates.required_acceptance: Human identity separation, per-effect consent, durable idempotency, authentic receipt and independently checked outcome
gates.required_evidence: Approval audit plus provider-signed receipt and second-source verification

gates.title: Approved isolated private staging and budget
gates.required_acceptance: Written provider/region and cost ceiling; nonpublic network, MFA, secrets, certificate and rollback controls
gates.required_evidence: Signed spend authorization, staging diagram and tested deployment evidence

gates.title: Authorized migrations and restoration
gates.required_acceptance: Review 012–015, explicit target approval, off-host backup, recovery objective, restore and rollback evidence
gates.required_evidence: Migration review, recovery report with timestamps and rollback proof

gates.title: Customer onboarding, consent and support
gates.required_acceptance: Approved onboarding, consent, data flow, tenant risk assessment, retention, escalation and support handbook
gates.required_evidence: Consented pilot enrollment and independently approved privacy packet

gates.title: Commercial pilot, costs, value and reliability
gates.required_acceptance: Authorized pilot bounds, real baseline/measurement, cost ceiling, service reliability, quality and complaints
gates.required_evidence: Real scoped pilot metrics, cost logs, customer approval and acceptance report

gates.title: Independent integrated security acceptance
gates.required_acceptance: Authenticated ingress, IDOR/tenant isolation, replay, secrets, rollback and patch retesting
gates.required_evidence: Independent assessment report, remediation traces, risk-owner dispositions

gates.title: Phase 01 and Phase 02 formal GO
gates.required_acceptance: All Phase 01 9/9 plus operational controls independently accepted; explicit signed GO
gates.required_evidence: Owner release authorization linked to immutable evidence and tested rollback

manual_release_rule: External authenticated approval, provider and security evidence must be assessed outside this JSON; editing this file cannot grant authorization.
